Mary - Album 1: Bloodlines

Wild Child

"I'm a WILD CHILD"

Age: 18
Musical direction: hardest skate-punk / fight-song track so far; loud gang harmonies, crunchy guitars, stomping drums, melodic shout-sing chorus, distorted bass, brief stripped acoustic/guitar section before the final explosion; raw raspy vocal, almost cracking in places.

[Intro — bus brakes / station announcement / guitar case hits floor]

Central Ridgefall.

One bag.

One guitar.

Thirty-two coins.

…

Could be worse.

Probably.

[Verse 1]
Bus door shuts behind me
Diesel smoke and neon signs
Eighteen years and nowhere waiting
Guess that means the road is mine

No one here knows where I came from
Good
I’d rather keep it that way

No one knows my mother’s name
Neither do I

Anyway

Band said I was getting stranger
Songs too dark and words too weird
Said nobody wants to hear about
Things that whisper when you’re scared

They wanted love songs
Summer nights
Something easy they could sell

I wrote shadows
Bones and warnings

Apparently that went to hell

[Pre-Chorus]
They said:

Karina,
Tone it down
Clean it up
Smile a little
Sing their stuff

I said:

No

They said:

Then you’re done, Karina

…

Okay.

[Chorus — gang vocals]
I’m a WILD CHILD
No leash
No chain

Throw me out
I’ll start again

No stage
No band
No master plan

Still got six strings
Still got two hands

I’m a WILD CHILD
Call me strange

I’d rather burn
Than rearrange

You want normal?

Wrong girl

Wrong life

Wrong damn world

[Verse 2]
They laughed when I wrote ghosts in windows
Things that crawl beneath your bed
Said I’m old enough to know that
Fairy tales are mostly dead

Funny

Everyone says monsters
Disappear when children grow

Maybe grown-ups stop believing
Because they’re scared of what they know

I believe the old folk stories
Every warning, every sign

Not because somebody proved them

Because too many stories rhyme

Different towns
Different centuries
Different gods and different names

Still they tell you:

Don’t go wandering

Still they tell you:

Fear the same

[Pre-Chorus]
Call it childish
Call it fake
Tell me what I’m supposed to take

I’ve heard footsteps
Seen strange lights

You weren’t there

So goodnight

[Chorus]
I’m a WILD CHILD
No leash
No chain

Throw me out
I’ll start again

No stage
No band
No master plan

Still got six strings
Still got two hands

I’m a WILD CHILD
Call me strange

I’d rather burn
Than rearrange

You want normal?

Wrong girl

Wrong life

Wrong damn world

[Instrumental — frantic guitar / station ambience woven into drums]

[Spoken / half-sung]

They said “Karina, you are difficult”

Cool.

They said “Karina, you’re unstable”.

Creative.

They said my songs make people uncomfortable.

…

Finally.

A compliment.

[Verse 3]
No parents waiting at the station
No one calling where I’ve been

Never knew them
Never had them

Can’t exactly miss what’s never seen

I learned early how to leave things
Before they got the chance to leave

Funny thing about believing—

Sometimes hope’s the weirdest thing to believe

So I’ll sing outside the cafés
Outside bars and corner stores

Drop a case beside my boots
And let the sidewalk be my floor

If they toss me fifty pennies
I can eat and play again

If they tell me I’m too strange—

Well

I’ve survived worse than them

[Breakdown — guitar only / breathy vocal]

One city

One night

One song

That’s enough

I don’t need forever

I just need

tomorrow

[Build — drums return]

Central’s loud
Central’s crowded
Everybody chasing something

Money
Fame
A better life

Fine

I’ll chase mine loudly

[Final Chorus — full lift / layered harmonies / strings underneath]
I’m a WILD CHILD
Still alive

No one gets to choose my side

No bloodline
No family name

No one waiting
Still I came

I’m a WILD CHILD
Hear me now

I’ll build a stage
From broken ground

Call me reckless
Call me strange

I’ve got nothing left to lose

And everything to make

[Post-Chorus — gang chant]

WILD CHILD!

Start again!

WILD CHILD!

No pretend!

WILD CHILD!

One guitar!

One more city!

Here we are!

[Outro — acoustic guitar / street ambience]

I pick a corner
Near the station

Open the case

Tune the strings

First night in Central Ridgefall

No friends

No home

No guarantee

…

Perfect.

[Guitar strum]

Let’s see who listens.

[CUT]
